name: Concept DB Pipeline Health Check
description: Verifies the concept-db relevance pipeline is healthy end-to-end: BM25/FTS search returns results, passive usage forwarding increments times_loaded, and no recent forward errors appear in journald. Emits conceptDbPipelineHealthReport and optionally triggers a systemd restart if critical failures are detected.

tasks.description: Call GET /concepts/search?q=substrate&limit=3 on the concept-db endpoint (localhost:18260) and check journalctl for RRF merge log lines confirming ftsCount > 0. Also capture the raw HTTP response body.

config.command: echo '=== HTTP response ===' && curl -sf 'http://127.0.0.1:18260/concepts/search?q=substrate&limit=3' 2>&1 || echo 'CURL_FAILED'; echo '=== journalctl RRF merge (last 50 lines) ===' && journalctl -u concept-db --no-pager -n 50 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '(rrf|bm25|fts|merge|ftsCount)' | tail -20 || echo 'JOURNAL_UNAVAILABLE'

tasks.description: Read a sample concept from concept-db before and after issuing a search request, asserting that times_loaded incremented. Use the concept-db HTTP API on port 18260.

config.command: echo '=== before ===' && curl -sf 'http://127.0.0.1:18260/concepts?limit=1' 2>&1 | head -5 || echo 'FETCH_FAILED_BEFORE'; echo '=== trigger usage ===' && curl -sf 'http://127.0.0.1:18260/concepts/search?q=vessel&limit=1' > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'SEARCH_OK' || echo 'SEARCH_FAILED'; echo '=== after ===' && curl -sf 'http://127.0.0.1:18260/concepts?limit=1' 2>&1 | head -5 || echo 'FETCH_FAILED_AFTER'; echo '=== journalctl usage forwarding (last 20 lines) ===' && journalctl -u concept-db --no-pager -n 100 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '(recordUsage|times_loaded|usage|forward)' | tail -20 || echo 'JOURNAL_UNAVAILABLE'

tasks.description: Scan journalctl for concept-db for any 'Failed to forward usage' lines in the last 5 minutes and count them.

config.command: SINCE=$(date -d '5 minutes ago' '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S' 2>/dev/null || date -v-5M '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [ -n "$SINCE" ]; then journalctl -u concept-db --no-pager --since "$SINCE" 2>/dev/null | grep -ic 'Failed to forward usage' || echo 0; else journalctl -u concept-db --no-pager -n 200 2>/dev/null | grep -ic 'Failed to forward usage' || echo 0; fi

tasks.description: Synthesise the results of the three prior tasks into a conceptDbPipelineHealthReport. If bm25_active is false or forward_errors_last_5min > 5, set needs_restart to true.

prompt.template:
You are producing a health report for the concept-db pipeline.

## Task 1 output — search + BM25 check
{{search-and-check-bm25_stdout}}

## Task 2 output — times_loaded increment check
{{check-times-loaded-increment_stdout}}

## Task 3 output — forward error count (raw number or text)
{{check-forward-errors_stdout}}

From the above, determine:
- bm25_active: true if the search returned at least one result AND the journal shows ftsCount > 0 (or shows any RRF/BM25 activity). If HTTP returned CURL_FAILED or result array is empty, set false.
- passive_usage_working: true if the journal shows recordUsage or times_loaded activity, or if the before/after concept data shows incremented usage. False if FETCH_FAILED or no usage lines found.
- forward_errors_last_5min: parse the numeric output from Task 3. If JOURNAL_UNAVAILABLE treat as 0.
- needs_restart: true if bm25_active is false OR forward_errors_last_5min > 5.
- summary: one sentence describing overall pipeline health.

Return only a JSON object with exactly these fields:
{
  "checked_at": "<ISO timestamp>",
  "bm25_active": <bool>,
  "passive_usage_working": <bool>,
  "forward_errors_last_5min": <number>,
  "needs_restart": <bool>,
  "summary": "<string>"
}
